topic: First marathon run in under two hours
core_question: Who was the first person to run a marathon distance in under two hours? (secondary: What is the capital city of Russia?)
answer_summary: The answer must name Eliud Kipchoge, who ran 1:59:40 in the 2019 INEOS 1:59 Challenge, as the first person to break the two-hour marathon barrier.; after the topic shift: Answer must be Moscow, the capital of Russia.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
